rulings.problem: `choice` is a declared Feat field and every key used is legal, but kind:'skills' + daily:true is a combination that reaches NO surface, so the pick silently does nothing - the exact outcome the triage answer forbade. src/rules/dailyChoices.ts:60 drops it from the Rest sheet by name ("'domains'/'skills' resolve against the BUILD, not the morning, so they never belong at rest"; only 'array' | 'text' | 'open' are collected). Worse, feats have no !def.daily guard on the builder path (src/builder/Builder.tsx:1315 renders content.feats[picked].choice unconditionally; the guard exists only for classFeatures at :1131), so the answer would land in BuildState.featChoices and wrongly survive a rest - and the triage's whole 'cannot be used as a prerequisite' argument rests on keeping it OUT of BuildState. The triage answer itself said kind:'open'|'array'; 'open' cannot express skills (OpenChoiceFrom.type has no skill kind), so 'array' is the only shape that works today.
